description: {"time": 1783112240738, "blocks": [{"id": "8p1gdvsxqd", "data": {"text": "Kifaru \u2014 meaning 'rhino' in Swahili \u2014 roared through Nairobi's routes under Rongao Sacco, its boxy silhouette transformed by airbrushed wildlife imagery and camouflage motifs. Dennis Muraguri's woodcut captures the rhinoceros in confident black strokes against negative space, a composition that mirrors the matatu's original design while distilling it into pure graphic impact. Rongao Sacco operates minibus routes connecting Nairobi's suburbs, their fleet known for bold colour schemes and wildlife-themed art that references Kenya's national parks. This print documents that connection between urban transport and the natural heritage that defines Kenyan identity. Printed as a high-quality c-type reproduction of the original woodcut, this A3 landscape print brings a piece of Nairobi's mobile gallery into your home.
